text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Heya-hey, Trainer! Did you rest up too?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to make the most of my time
off, so I didn't put my name down for
any shifts. I haven't
felt this relaxed in
ages!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...But I do get antsy when there's nothing
to do.
Ahaha, maybe I had a little too
much time on my
hands.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
After all that restlessness,
I think I need
some
good ol' training to set me
straight! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not only is Ines Fujin in high spirits,
but
she seems
well rested, too!
